title: Ditto's Perfect Transformation Can Fail
premise: Ditto can perfectly transform, but laughter makes it lose the disguise.
audiencePromise: See the strange rule that breaks Ditto's supposedly perfect transformation.
openLoop: How can a perfect transformation fail without copying badly?
payoff: Even a perfect transformation cannot survive Ditto being made to laugh.
engagementQuestion: A clever weakness or a ridiculous flaw?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and playfully. Stress perfect and laugh. Pause briefly before the weakness reveal.

scenes.headline: LAUGHTER BREAKS PERFECTION
scenes.narration: Ditto's perfect disguise breaks when you make it laugh.
scenes.caption: PERFECT... UNTIL IT LAUGHS

scenes.headline: CELLS BECOME THE COPY
scenes.narration: Ditto can copy what it sees by rearranging its cells.
scenes.caption: IT REARRANGES ITS CELLS

scenes.headline: MEMORY CAN MISS DETAILS
scenes.narration: But memory-based transformations sometimes get their details wrong.
scenes.caption: MEMORY-BASED COPIES CAN FAIL

scenes.headline: MADE TO LAUGH? DISGUISE FAILS
scenes.narration: Make Ditto laugh, and it cannot maintain the disguise.
scenes.caption: LAUGHTER BREAKS THE DISGUISE

scenes.headline: LAUGHTER NEEDS NO BAD COPY
scenes.narration: It can be perfect, yet laughter still stops Ditto maintaining it.
scenes.caption: PERFECT COPY. SAME RESULT.

scenes.headline: CLEVER OR RIDICULOUS?
scenes.narration: A clever weakness or a ridiculous flaw?
scenes.caption: CLEVER WEAKNESS OR RIDICULOUS FLAW?
